title: Fan Techniques
body:
Syntax: fan techniques <target> [direction]

Description: A Mighty Fan attack that may knock the target off balance. If a surviving target and an open exit are specified, the gust pushes them through that exit; closed doors and hidden exits block it. Requires Wind chakra nature. Base damage: 137-161. 35% chance to inflict off balance. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 40. Costs 35 Chakra and 20 Stamina; 7 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
